decisions.reason: Preserving all existing campaigns does not change the MeetAlfred configuration requirement or its Pro subscription plan.
The instruction protects existing campaigns but does not modify or resume the deferred HubSpot-to-MeetAlfred synchronization requirement.
The testing restrictions in the same source message are already fully represented by this candidate's message-222 INTRODUCE Event; the campaign-preservation change adds no further state change.
Protecting existing campaigns from removal does not change or resume the deferred deliverable to configure an automated email campaign.
The source protects existing campaigns as assets but does not change the required channel, automation mode, or platform of the automated LinkedIn campaign.
The preservation instruction does not alter or resume the deferred silent-lead follow-up workflow.
Preserving existing MeetAlfred campaigns does not change or resume the deferred Zapier configuration requirement.
The source concerns preservation of existing MeetAlfred campaigns, not creation of the campaign domain.
The instruction not to remove existing campaigns or use production leads for testing does not alter the HubSpot lead-management features.
The source does not change whether email and LinkedIn communication histories must be visible in HubSpot.
The campaign-preservation decision does not modify the independent requirement to warm up the campaign domain.
The source does not change the required form of LinkedIn profile URLs stored in the CRM.
